title: lavender smoke: kick floods, snare flashes, hats crisp
story: See You Again is a half-time R&B groove at about 52 bpm (onset lag 37 ticks; the tracker's 136 bpm is the eighth grid). The verse is thin and dreamy (rms 0.12): only the snare is carried, each strong snare flashing the lavender smoke and opening its contrast for a moment. At 2430 the drop floods the smoke (densidad 1.0 to 1.6), the light swings to the far side (luz_dir 1.2 to 4.0) and the contrast opens. After it the kick, the snare and the hats carry the groove, the light and hue swing every two beats, and the smoke settles at a steady density for the post-roll.
